description: This file contains functions for generating XML test summaries, including functions for writing test suite, test case, failure, and skipped test entries, as well as initializing and shutting down the summary report.

methods.name: int clar_summary_close_tag(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * tag,int indent)
methods.description: Writes an XML close tag for the given tag name with indentation based on the indent level.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testsuite(struct clar_summary * summary,int idn,const char * name,time_t timestamp,int test_count,int fail_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Writes an opening <testsuite> tag with attributes such as id, name, hostname, timestamp, test count, fail count, and error count.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testcase(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * name,const char * classname,double elapsed)
methods.description: Writes an opening <testcase> tag with name, classname, and elapsed time.

methods.name: int clar_summary_failure(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)
methods.description: Writes a <failure> tag with type, message, and description inside CDATA.

methods.name: struct:clar_summary * clar_summary_init(const char * filename)
methods.description: Initializes a clar_summary struct, opens the output file, and allocates memory.

methods.name: int clar_summary_shutdown(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Finalizes the report by closing tags, writing report details, and freeing resources.

ctags.name: clar_summary_failure
ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)

ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,const char * name,const char * classname,double elapsed)
